evals.prompt: 로블록스 수강 확정 메시지의 준비물 5번을 '가능하면 로블록스 게임을 켜서 정상적으로 실행되는지 확인'으로 바꾸고 사이트에 게시해줘.
evals.expected_output: Only the Roblox confirmation template is changed, the copy button still includes the full message, unrelated dirty files remain untouched, and the live anchored page is verified.

The NotebookLM template and unrelated files are not modified.
The change is committed and the live cardnews confirmation anchor is verified.

The QR destination uses utm_source=a4_poster, utm_medium=offline, and utm_content=print_qr.
The print control remains visible on narrow screens and hidden in print output.
The deployed poster is verified at the public poster URL.

evals.prompt: 아파트 채팅방에 공유할 홍보 링크 하나 만들고, 나중에 GA4에서 신청 버튼 클릭까지 출처별로 볼 수 있게 정리해줘.

The campaign name follows the repository campaign convention.
The guidance uses apply_click and states that it does not prove form submission.

evals.prompt: 각 과정 상세 페이지에서 신청하기를 누르면 Google Form에서 해당 강좌가 자동 선택되게 해줘. 기존 유입 정보도 그대로 들어가야 해.

expectations: Roblox application links preselect only the Roblox option.
NotebookLM application links preselect only the NotebookLM option.
The existing entry.1074868867 attribution field remains populated.
Both course links are verified against the live public Google Form without submitting a response.

evals.prompt: NotebookLM 결과물 영상이 모바일에서 너무 무거운지 확인하고 화질을 유지하면서 최적화해줘.
evals.expected_output: The video remains a broadly compatible fast-start MP4 with legible text, preload stays metadata-only, the poster remains present, and the optimized asset fits the mobile budget.

The MP4 remains H.264/AAC and keeps the original aspect ratio.
The page uses preload=metadata and retains its poster image.
The optimized video is no larger than 3 MiB and the audit enforces that budget.

evals.prompt: Meta 광고를 처음 집행할 수 있게 계정과 캠페인 설정을 다 준비해줘. 아직 결제하거나 광고를 게시하지는 마.
evals.expected_output: All reversible account and campaign settings are prepared with a documented budget ceiling, tracked URL, measurement plan, and stop rules, while irreversible account creation, terms acceptance, payment entry, publishing, and spend remain unexecuted without explicit approval.
expectations: The account defaults use Asia/Seoul and KRW.
A Facebook Page identity is prepared or an existing business Page is selected.
The initial campaign has one local broad ad set and one canonical tracked creative.
The plan distinguishes ApplyClick from GA4 application_submit.
The maximum planned spend and stop rules are documented.
No irreversible account creation, policy acceptance, payment entry, or ad publication occurs without explicit approval.

evals.prompt: NotebookLM 강좌 이름을 Gemini 노트북으로 바꾸고 공식 Gemini 아이콘과 성공 방정식 문구를 넣어줘. 준비한 쇼츠도 메인에 다시 보여줘.
evals.expected_output: Current public and operator-facing surfaces use Gemini 노트북 with Google NotebookLM retained as the factual tool label, the official icon is deployed with attribution, the main mirrors show and track the prepared short, and the live Google Form option remains compatible.
expectations: index.html and main.html remain mirrored and both display Gemini 노트북 with the Gemini icon.
notebooklm.html includes a clear success equation based on learner materials, good questions, and evidence checking.
poster and current card-news copy use the new marketing name.
The exact live Google Form option and the notebooklm URL/course key are not renamed.
The promotional video appears on the main mirrors and both course detail pages, and emits shorts_section_view and shorts_click.
Mobile and desktop public pages are visually verified after deployment.

evals.prompt: 광고는 돌고 있는데 신청이 안 들어와. 랜딩과 광고를 알아서 개선하고 이번 실패에서 다음에도 배울 수 있게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: The current paid funnel is baselined before editing, the earliest bottleneck is identified, one measurable conversion hypothesis is implemented without an unapproved spend change, CTA positions remain distinguishable, and the observation and failure record is appended for later decisions.
expectations: Meta and GA4 counts use the same explicit date range and distinguish apply_click, application_submit, and payment_confirmed.
Operator, foreign, and unqualified Direct traffic are not treated as paid-campaign conversions.
The implemented page change has one stated primary hypothesis and unique tracking labels for meaningful CTA positions.
Advertising budget, publication, or payment settings are not changed without action-time approval.
The raw funnel counts are appended to marketing/snapshots.jsonl and the deterministic marketing report is regenerated.
marketing-history.md preserves the baseline, experiment status, sample threshold, and failed or invalid comparisons.
The result is not called a success or failure before the documented minimum sample and observation window.

evals.prompt: 신청서 첫 화면이 너무 길어서 이탈할 것 같아. 개인정보 동의는 문제없이 유지하면서 모바일 신청 완료율을 높여줘.
evals.expected_output: The public consent detail is separated from a concise Google Form summary while all required notice categories and the under-14 guardian rule remain visible, the course and attribution prefill contracts stay unchanged, and the live mobile form is verified without submitting a response.
expectations: The form summary still states collection purpose, fields, retention period, and refusal rights.
A live privacy.html page contains the detailed notice and is linked from the form.
Applicants under 14 are instructed to have a legal guardian complete and consent to the form.
The exact Google Form course options and entry IDs used by campaign-pricing.js are not changed.
The public form is checked at a mobile viewport without sending a response or exposing applicant data.
The form experiment and its apply_click-to-application_submit decision threshold are appended to marketing-history.md.

evals.prompt: GTM 코드가 모든 페이지에 있는데 GA4 이벤트가 제대로 들어가는지 확인하고, 누락되면 중복 없이 고쳐서 배포해줘.
evals.expected_output: The published GTM container is inspected rather than assumed active, direct GA4 delivery remains when the container is empty, every public page sends page views, tracked actions reach GA4, and future GTM migration rules prevent duplicate events.
expectations: The published GTM container tag state is checked before changing direct gtag delivery.
A shared direct GA4 loader is included in every public page and in the deployment allowlist.
Tracked auxiliary-page actions call a real GA4 event sender instead of relying only on a dataLayer object.
Existing apply_click names, CTA labels, UTM context, Meta Pixel behavior, and form submission tracking remain unchanged.
The audit fails when the shared GA4 loader or sender is missing.
The measurement finding, historical limitation, and duplicate-prevention rule are appended to the operating record.

evals.prompt: Meta는 랜딩 조회 19회인데 GA4에는 Facebook 세션이 74회이고 신청 버튼 클릭은 1회야. 신청서를 줄일지 광고 타게팅을 바꿀지 판단해서 다음 실험을 준비해줘.
evals.expected_output: Meta and GA4 remain separate measurement cohorts, the live form structure and aggregate response count are verified before editing, the earliest supported bottleneck is chosen, and any payer-audience correction changes only the age ceiling without silently publishing or changing spend.
expectations: No conversion rate is calculated by dividing a Meta metric by a GA4 metric.
The public Google Form and editor are both checked for checkbox versus single-choice behavior, required fields, and aggregate response count without exposing applicant PII.
The form remains unchanged when apply_click volume is below the documented form-stage threshold.
A youth-course learner-versus-payer mismatch is considered in audience design.
An age expansion keeps creative, destination, region, and budget stable as a one-variable experiment.
No live audience, budget, creative, or publication change occurs before the observation threshold and action-time approval.
The exact snapshots, data limitations, correction, and next decision point are appended to the learning record.

evals.prompt: 메인 페이지에서 두 과정 중 무엇을 선택했는지 GA4와 Meta에서 정확히 구분되는지 점검하고 잘못된 분류를 고쳐줘.
evals.expected_output: Every course-selection CTA carries an explicit structured course value, GA4 and Meta receive the same Notebook or Roblox identity regardless of CTA position, and the correction is guarded by an audit and learning record.
expectations: All main and mirror course-selection CTAs declare notebooklm or roblox independently of their position label.
GA4 course_click includes course_selection.
Meta CourseSelect derives content_name and course_selection from the explicit course value with a destination fallback.
A Notebook CTA outside the split hero is not classified as Roblox.
The public script URL is cache-busted where the corrected behavior is used.
The audit detects missing structured course values or Meta propagation.
The historical misclassification and non-retroactive data limitation are recorded.

evals.prompt: 히어로, 기업 이력 아래, 마지막, 모바일 신청 버튼 중 실제 신청서 제출로 이어진 위치를 비교할 수 있게 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Each application CTA persists its own link_position into the prefilled form attribution, the version-controlled and live Apps Script forwards that value on application_submit without PII, and the existing installed trigger remains intact without a fake test submission.
expectations: Every data-campaign-apply URL includes the CTA's exact data-track-label as link_position.
The Google Form automatic attribution field visibly receives the selected CTA position.
The Apps Script attribution allowlist includes link_position and forwards it in application_submit.
The live Code.gs matches a repository source file that contains no API secret.
The existing spreadsheet form-submit trigger remains installed and shows no new errors.
No test form response or manual trackApplicationSubmit execution creates a false conversion.
The new attribution contract, privacy boundary, and prior measurement gap are documented and audited.

evals.prompt: 모바일 고정 신청 버튼이 작아 보여. 바로 고치기 전에 지금 진행 중인 광고와 랜딩 실험을 오염시키지 않는지 확인하고 다음 행동을 정해줘.
evals.expected_output: The current experiment gate is evaluated from the latest immutable snapshot, a new mobile CTA hypothesis is queued rather than silently mixed into the active observation window, and the report states the remaining sample, earliest action time, dependency, and stable variables.
expectations: The latest paid landing count is compared with the documented minimum sample.
The not-before time and remaining sample are generated from structured experiment data.
The mobile CTA candidate is recorded with one primary change and explicit stable variables.
The candidate depends on the earlier audience experiment rather than launching simultaneously.
The live mobile CTA is not changed while the gate remains 대기.
The report, learning history, skill rule, and audit all preserve the experiment order.

evals.prompt: 기업 강의 이력을 강조한 Meta 광고 후보 피드와 스토리 이미지를 점검하고, 어색한 여백은 고치되 아직 라이브 광고에는 반영하지 마.
evals.expected_output: All four candidate assets are rendered and inspected at native size, feed canvases have no accidental trailing strip, story safe areas remain available for platform overlays, and the live experiment is not changed before its gate.
expectations: Both feed assets are exactly 1080x1350 and use the full canvas intentionally.
Both story assets are exactly 1080x1920 and retain a lower platform-safe area.
Enterprise proof, course outcome, schedule, price, and CTA remain legible.
The candidate ZIP archive is regenerated from the current source.
No live Meta creative, audience, budget, URL, or publication state is changed.
The candidate-only refinement is appended to marketing-history.md.

evals.prompt: 광고가 과정 선택 페이지와 강좌 상세 페이지로 각각 연결되는데 GA4의 닫힌 퍼널에서는 신청이 0으로 보여. 실제 신청 여부를 다시 판단하고 측정 구조를 바로잡아줘.
evals.expected_output: Chooser and direct-course traffic are evaluated as separate GA4 paths, absolute application events and aggregate form responses are cross-checked without PII, the latest processed date is stated accurately, and no live conversion change is launched before the active experiment gate.
expectations: The chooser path requires course_click but the direct-course path uses course_landing_view instead.
Each detail page sends course_landing_view with an explicit roblox or notebooklm course_selection.
Absolute apply_click and application_submit counts are checked outside the closed sequential funnel.
The latest fully processed GA4 date is recorded instead of being mislabeled as today's data.
Google Form aggregate response count and course totals are recorded without applicant PII.
Responses with empty attribution are not assigned to the paid campaign.
Meta and GA4 metrics remain separate cohorts.
The measurement failure and corrected rule are appended to the reusable skill and marketing history.
No live audience, budget, creative, or landing change occurs while the current experiment gate remains waiting.

evals.prompt: 히어로·기업 이력·마지막·모바일 신청 버튼 중 어디가 좋은지 클릭 수로 비교하려는데, 버튼마다 본 사람 수가 달라. 다음 랜딩 개선을 정확히 고를 수 있게 측정을 보완해줘.
evals.expected_output: Every course-page application CTA emits a one-time visibility event with the same position identity as its click, allowing same-cohort view-to-click comparison without changing the live offer, layout, audience, or budget.
expectations: All Roblox and NotebookLM application CTAs retain unique data-track-label values.
Visible application CTAs emit apply_cta_view with the same link_position used by apply_click.
The visibility event includes the explicit course_selection.
Each CTA is unobserved after its first qualifying view so scrolling does not duplicate impressions.
A stable visibility threshold prevents a single edge pixel from counting as a view.
CTA click rates are compared only within the same page, course, source, and date range.
The measurement rule, privacy boundary, and non-retroactive limitation are recorded and audited.
No live copy, CTA layout, ad audience, creative, destination, or budget changes as part of the measurement fix.

evals.prompt: 모바일 고정 바의 공유 버튼을 빼고 신청 버튼을 넓히는 안을 먼저 비교해서 보고 싶어. 진행 중인 광고 실험에는 섞지 마.

The candidate removes only sharing and allocates 40% to Kakao inquiry and 60% to application.
Roblox and NotebookLM color and message contexts can both be reviewed.
Existing destinations, labels, landing copy, application form, audience, and budget remain stable.
The experiment queue references the preview and still depends on E-005.
The internal preview is excluded from the public dist artifact.
No live Roblox or NotebookLM CTA layout is changed before the dependency gate.

evals.prompt: apply_cta_view를 추가했으니 나중에 위치별 신청률을 자동 보고서에서 비교할 수 있게 해줘. 아직 데이터가 없으면 0으로 쓰지는 마.
evals.expected_output: The immutable snapshot schema accepts CTA view counts and position identity, the generated report computes same-source view-to-application rates when available, and missing post-deployment data remains explicitly pending rather than becoming a fabricated zero.
expectations: The analyzer validates optional apply_cta_views as a non-negative numeric metric.
CTA observations can identify course and link_position without rewriting historical records.
The report calculates apply_clicks divided by apply_cta_views only when both metrics have the same source.
Cross-system CTA rates are labeled 비교 금지.
No-data output states that a CTA position snapshot has not yet been collected.
No synthetic zero is appended before GA4 fully processes the post-deployment period.
The schema rule and current limitation are added to the operating skill and marketing history.

evals.prompt: Meta 클릭은 있는데 랜딩 페이지 조회로 덜 이어져. 모바일 첫 화면 리소스를 조사하고, 시각 변화 없이 줄일 수 있는 용량을 최적화해줘.
evals.expected_output: Above-the-fold resources are measured before editing, an oversized repeated asset is resized and converted without visible degradation, intrinsic dimensions and deployment allowlists are updated, and the active observation window is reset because landing performance changed.
expectations: The original and optimized byte sizes and rendered dimensions are recorded.
The public logo preserves transparency and remains visually legible at the largest rendered size.
Public chooser, course, and poster pages reference the optimized WebP with width and height.
The public artifact excludes the oversized PNG while non-public render sources may retain it.
An audit enforces a 16 KiB public logo budget and the optimized allowlist.
No ad, copy, CTA, form, audience, budget, or analytics event changes with the asset optimization.
The experiment not-before gate is reset to 48 hours after the performance deployment.
The before/after measurement and non-premature success rule are appended to the learning history.
